anti_overlap: Does NOT cover transport interface design (fd-broadcast-*) or archive provenance (fd-archival-*)
decision_lens: Lock the source before migrating, verify the target before unlocking, and maintain a complete audit trail that survives both systems
distance_rationale: Clinical trial transfers operate under extreme audit and safety requirements that reveal gaps in less regulated migration plans
expected_isomorphisms: Subject ID mapping maps to user identity crosswalk; locked-source protocol maps to Auraken freeze before decommission; reconciliation criteria map to migration validation checks
focus: Reviews the migration sequencing and safety through the lens of clinical trial site transfers — locked-source protocol, reconciliation, and audit continuity
name: fd-clinical-trial-site-transfer
persona: Clinical data manager who has transferred multi-site trial data between eClinical systems while maintaining 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
review_areas: Subject identifier mapping: user identity crosswalk validated before any data moves
Audit trail continuity: preference extraction events traceable across the migration boundary
Locked-source-before-decommission: Auraken data frozen before Intercom becomes authoritative
Reconciliation criteria: row counts, checksum comparisons, edge case validation
pgvector dependency gate: is the extension a hard requirement or can migration proceed without it?
Concurrent operation safety: can two systems write to the same user's preference history simultaneously?

severity_examples.condition: Profile generation oscillates between conflicting preference sets
severity_examples.scenario: Both systems write preference entities for the same user during concurrent operation, creating contradictory histories

severity_examples.condition: Silent data loss discovered weeks later when user reports missing preferences
severity_examples.scenario: No reconciliation step — migration declared complete without verifying row counts or data integrity
Auraken not locked before decommission — late writes lost during cutover window

source_domain: Clinical data management and eClinical system migration
success_hints: Explicit lock-migrate-verify-unlock sequence; reconciliation script with row count + checksum comparison; concurrent operation uses single-writer-per-user arbitration; audit events span both systems
task_context: 11-child epic migrating Auraken to Skaffen/Intercom. Phase 4 decommissions Python runtime. Users have live accumulated data. Concurrent operation period between old and new systems required.
